page.overview:
What is Lysandra Yaxley?

Lysandra Black (née Yaxley) (fl. 1915-1919) was a pure-blood witch who married Arcturus Black (II). The couple had three daughters together: Callidora, Cedrella, and Charis Black. Through Cedrella, who was disowned for marrying "blood traitor" Septimus Weasley, she was the maternal grandmother of Arthur Weasley.

Lysandra may be related to the Death Eater Corban Yaxley. Following her eldest daughter Callidora and Harfang Longbottom's marriage, she became the grandmother of their son and daughter. Lysandra was also the maternal grandmother of her youngest daughter Charis and Caspar Crouch's three children.

Lysandra is the feminine form of the Greek name , meaning "a release of man" or "liberty". It was the name of Spartan general and a character in William Shakespeare's A Midsummer Night's Dream.
